subject: Urgent: VP attendance constraint and coverage plan for platform walkthrough
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 platform walkthrough — draft agenda attached

Alex / Marissa —

Attaching the latest agenda for the Tidal AI walkthrough next week. Nora confirmed Greg (their CTO) wants a short architecture deep-dive up front and then a ops/SLAs section. Nora also mentioned a possible VP-level attendee from the procurement side — she said she'd confirm by Tuesday.

Can you both review the agenda and flag any sections you want to expand/trim? If a VP is joining, we should reserve the first 20 minutes for exec-level outcomes and leave a backup presenter for the CTO deep-dive in case of last-minute changes.

Attachments: demo-agenda-v3.pdf

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Nora Jacobs <nora@tidalai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 platform walkthrough — draft agenda attached

Lauren —

Quick update: Greg will attend only if our VP of Engineering, Priya Anand, is on the call for the first 25 minutes. Priya is focusing on vendor risk and cost predictability; if she sees the right exec-level positioning up front, Greg will stay for the technical section.

Priya's schedule is tight — she may join near the start then have to jump to a board prep meeting. Is it possible to shift the call 30 minutes earlier on Apr 16 so Priya can attend the opening 25 minutes from her hotel (she's traveling from the East Coast)? If we can't move, can we guarantee a short executive summary that Priya can join for, and then have someone step in to run the architecture deep-dive so Greg doesn't drop?

Thanks,
Nora
Nora Jacobs
Head of Platform Partnerships, Tidal AI
nora@tidalai.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Nora Jacobs <nora@tidalai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:08:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 platform walkthrough — draft agenda attached

Nora — thanks for the heads-up and the context. Short answer: we can try to shift 30 minutes earlier, but I need confirmation from Priya's assistant (and a quick sanity check on VP travel connectivity). If Priya is on only for the first ~25 minutes, we should treat that as a constrained window and make the first block tightly scripted.

Proposed plan:
- Option A (preferred): Move meeting 30 minutes earlier to Apr 16 09:00 PDT. Priya attends first 25 mins. Jonas will open with the exec summary and high-level outcomes (5 min), then I hand off to Lauren for contract/pricing points (5 min), then Jonas will do a 15-min executive ops/SLAs highlight before we transition to the technical deep-dive.
- Option B (if we cannot move): Keep existing time (09:30 PDT) — Priya may only make last 10 minutes. Jonas will record a 10-min executive highlight and we will tag an explicit 5-min recap at the start of the technical block so Greg can rejoin after a quick check. We'll make sure the architecture slides are annotated with the key CTO asks.

Can you confirm Priya's timezone (EST?) and connectivity (hotel wifi good / will she be dialing from a mobile)? If you can share her assistant's contact, I'll try to get the calendar updated this afternoon. I'm attaching a short VP-level one-pager (excerpted from the agenda) and a travel itinerary stub we received in case we need to coordinate times.

Attachments: vp-travel-itinerary.pdf

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nora Jacobs <nora@tidalai.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 platform walkthrough — draft agenda attached

Nora / Alex —

Update after quick sync with Priya's assistant: Priya can only attend if the meeting is at 08:30 PDT (11:30 EDT) — she has a board prep call at 12:00 EDT and will be in transit the rest of the afternoon. Moving the whole session earlier to 08:30 will cause conflicts for three of our team members and for Tidal's PM. So rather than force a full reschedule, here's the execution plan we agreed on:

1) Keep the existing 09:30 PDT slot on Apr 16 (as originally calendared).
2) Jonas will prepare a 12-minute exec summary deck and will open the meeting with: outcomes (2m), cost/unit economics highlights (4m), and SLA/rollback guarantees (6m). Jonas will record that segment and mark the recording start so Priya can watch the first 12 minutes live and then reference the recording later if she misses anything.
3) Alex will annotate the architecture deep-dive slides with clear CTO-facing callouts so Greg has a short path to the details if he needs to jump in and out.
4) If Priya can dial in for even 10 minutes at the start, Jonas will be on camera and will run the executive points live; otherwise the recorded segment will be shared immediately after the call.

Marissa — please update the calendar invite to add the recording marker and attach the VP one-pager. Alex — can you and Jonas run a 20-min dry run tomorrow at 11:00 PDT to lock the script (I flagged the dry-run on your calendars). Nora — appreciate you flagging the VP constraint; we'll make sure Priya sees the exec highlights.

Thanks,
Lauren
